svg.title: Cluster streaming separates control requests from mounted image reads
svg.desc: The local desktop sends settings and review responses over SSH. Slurm allocates one node and one task with requested resources. Pipeline stage calculations and persistent analysis outputs remain on cluster storage; job identities and current review records return to the local application. Local QuPath views a prepared OME-Zarr image through a read-only mounted root: its viewport requests a level and rectangle, the native server reads the relevant shard index and encoded chunk ranges, and decoded tiles populate a bounded local cache. This illustrates prepared Zarr access; vendor image readers follow their own regional storage layout. No throughput claim or completed cluster deployment is implied.
